cohort: Fetal rabbits from pregnant does at 28 days of gestation, randomized to receive either medication (atropine-cisatracurium-fentanyl) or saline injection, or used as a control.
finding: Fetal medication (atropine-cisatracurium-fentanyl) in a rabbit model does not appear to lead to significant short-term neurocognitive effects, with comparable neonatal body weights, brain-to-body weight ratios, neuromotoric functioning, neuron density, and proliferation, though sham pups had lower hippocampal synaptic density.
gest_age: 28 days gestation (at injection), at term (at birth)
